MOZ.note: The document states no data protection law; it mentions only a data protection training session.

facts.fact: INTIC reports a 12 May 2026 workshop in Beira validating public consultations on the proposed Estrategia Nacional de Transformacao Digital, to improve its preliminary version, pillars, KPIs and governance model.

MOZ.note: The document says the strategy should be inclusive of persons with disabilities but states no accessibility law, policy or programme.

facts.fact: INTIC says regional consultations on the draft national digital transformation strategy collected contributions from public and private sectors, academics, civil society, youth, women and persons with disabilities, in Cabo Delgado, Zambezia, Maputo and Sofala, with a validation workshop in Beira on 12 May 2026.
